body.summary: 2142a074: new src/workflow/code-review/dimensions/test-record-view.ts builds the per-file view (latest run by ranAt chosen before the entry is checked; malformed latest entry is an unverified barrier; timed-out/non-zero/title-less handled; older-only titles listed as notInLatestRun; BUILD per-task passed or 'unavailable'; notes for entries without a file name and tasks without files). coverage.ts renders it as a trailing JSON section before ## Output and states the pass/unverified rule; with no TESTS record the every-test-unverified text stays. Eight falsifying mutations (storage order, tie, barrier, timeout reason, notInLatestRun, BUILD passed, section not rendered, notes) each fail the named test. tsc clean; workflow/daemon-steps/MCP suites 2298 pass, only the pre-existing review-decision failure.
